narrative: On the board. A foul leaf at the lodging table. The afternoon play is not this leaf. On the board. Two further lines. The margin beside them is empty. On the board. The empty margin, ruled and unused. No word is written in it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the four pressures of the house and left the margin blank.

entities.name: the Capulet kitchen
entities.context: Shown on draft in The cooks, before anyone finds a pause
